# Before and after panels

Place alternatives in a shared composition using the before and after panels layout.

Model: `before-after` · Family: Comparisons · Status: **in review**.

[Getting started](../../USING-STUDIO.md) · [All slide guides](../GUIDES.md) · [Current LaTeX source](../../../templates/studio/before-after.tex)

[Open this slide individually](../index.html?template=before-after)

![Before and after panels](../previews/before-after.png)

The preview shows the shipped defaults. The thin bottom label belongs to the review catalogue.

## Insert this slide

Place this command outside another `frame`:

```latex
\studiotemplate{before-after}
```

## Change the content

This example uses supported fields. Omitted fields keep their shipped defaults.

```latex
\studiotemplate[
  title={690\texteuro{}},
  text-1={in 2020}
]{before-after}
```

## Complete one-slide example

Create `my-slide.tex` in the project root and paste:

```latex
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\usetheme{bitpolito-studio}
\usepackage{bitpolitostudiotemplates}
\usepackage[backend=biber]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{bibliography.bib}
\begin{document}
\studiotemplate[
  title={690\texteuro{}},
  text-1={in 2020}
]{before-after}
\end{document}
```

```sh
python3 scripts/build.py my-slide.tex
# Installed TeX alternative:
python3 scripts/build.py my-slide.tex --backend native
```

Output: `build/my-slide.pdf`. On Windows use `py -3` instead of `python3`.

## Editable fields

Positions and available space refer to the original, fixed composition.
In the individual web view, select a field or enable **Show editable areas** to locate it.

| Field | What it changes | Position | Available space | Shipped value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>graphic-1</code> | Replaceable graphic or decoration (graphic) | middle left | 14.6% wide × 12.2% high | <code>\includegraphics[width=520\studiounit]{images/studio/collection/figma-0742-part-01.pdf}</code> |
| <code>graphic-2</code> | Replaceable graphic or decoration (graphic) | lower left | 14.9% wide × 12.2% high | <code>\includegraphics[width=531\studiounit]{images/studio/collection/figma-0742-part-02.pdf}</code> |
| <code>graphic-3</code> | Replaceable graphic or decoration (graphic) | middle right | 14.6% wide × 12.2% high | <code>\includegraphics[width=520\studiounit]{images/studio/collection/figma-0742-part-03.pdf}</code> |
| <code>text-1</code> | Editable text (text) | middle left | 6.3% wide × 3.2% high | <code>in 2020</code> |
| <code>text-2</code> | Editable text (text) | upper left | 16.3% wide × 12.0% high | <code>Kept under\\the mattress</code> |
| <code>text-3</code> | Editable text (text) | lower left | 6.3% wide × 3.2% high | <code>in 2025</code> |
| <code>title</code> | Main text (text) | lower right | 42.7% wide × 16.8% high | <code>690\texteuro{}</code> |
| <code>text-5</code> | Editable text (text) | middle right | 48.6% wide × 3.2% high | <code>in 2020</code> |
| <code>text-6</code> | Editable text (text) | upper right | 47.4% wide × 12.2% high | <code>Invested in\\Bitcoin</code> |
| <code>text-7</code> | Editable text (text) | lower right | 48.6% wide × 3.2% high | <code>in 2025</code> |

Truncated values are shown in full at the start of the current source file.
A text field accepts LaTeX; a graphic field accepts an icon, `\includegraphics`, TikZ or math.

## Replace a graphic

This example fits an icon inside the first graphic slot, preserving its proportions:

```latex
\studiotemplate[
  graphic-1={\asset[width=0.13161\paperwidth,height=0.10935\paperheight,keepaspectratio]{alice}}
]{before-after}
```

Use any graphic field listed above to target another slot. Some slots contain a complete
panel, background, screenshot or decoration. Inspect the preview before replacing them.

## Keep the composition

- Keep replacements within their allocated boxes. Shorten text or use explicit `\\` line breaks.
- Use `field={}` to hide content while retaining its space.
- Fonts, anchors and geometry remain fixed; unknown fields and overflowing content produce diagnostics.
- Text colour does not recolour supplied graphics; prepare another asset when its fixed colours must change.
- Some diagrams, QR codes and decorations are native source elements rather than configurable fields.
- For structural changes, edit [the current source](../../../templates/studio/before-after.tex). Catalogues and the showcase reuse it.
